tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Returns Huntay AzerTürk's open slots for a 30-minute intro video call (Google Meet), read live from his booking calendar (Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00 Istanbul time). Use when the user wants to schedule a call with Huntay AzerTürk.

tools.name: book_intro_call
tools.description: Books a 30-minute intro video call (Google Meet) with Huntay AzerTürk at a slot returned by get_availability, using the attendee's name and email; Cal.com emails the calendar invitation. Call only after the user has confirmed the slot and their details.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the consulting and development services offered by Huntay AzerTürk, with links. If need is given (the user's problem or project in their own words), services are ranked by fit and each includes the matching item from its service page. Use when the user asks which of Huntay AzerTürk's services

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Returns full details of one of Huntay AzerTürk's services: who it is for, deliverables, use cases, technologies and FAQ (including how pricing works). Use the slug from list_services.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns the professional profile of Huntay AzerTürk (software architect, Istanbul): background, current role, experience highlights, languages and contact links. Use when the user asks about Huntay AzerTürk himself.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the content of huntayazerturk.com — Huntay AzerTürk's services, case studies, FAQ, work experience and articles — by keyword. Returns matching documents (id, title, url); pass an id to fetch for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text of a document from search, by its id (e.g. "service:ai-agents" or "case-study:ai-ops").

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: get_profile, search, fetch · Public sink: book_intro_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: get_profile, search, fetch · Public sink: book_intro_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
